description: This file defines a Flutter widget for adding or editing a financial transaction. It includes form fields for category, amount, note, and date, manages state, loads data from repositories, and saves or updates transactions.

classes.name: AddTransactionScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that presents a form to add or edit a transaction.

classes.name: _AddTransactionScreenState
classes.description: State class handling the form logic, data loading, and saving for AddTransactionScreen.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the widget state, loads categories, and sets initial values if editing.

methods.name: _loadCats
methods.description: Loads categories from the CategoryRepository asynchronously.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of text controllers to free resources.

methods.name: _save
methods.description: Validates the form, constructs a TransactionModel, and adds or updates it via the repository.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including form fields and buttons.
